classification.difficultyReason: Combine supplementary, vertically opposite, alternate and triangle angles using numerical givens.

content.prompt: Determine the value represented by each pronumeral.

spec.description: Two marked oblique parallel lines intersect two transversals forming a triangle; all seven unknowns remain in their source sectors.
spec.mathematics: Parallel lines, straight angles, vertically opposite angles and triangle angle sum. Givens are 107° and 45°.
spec.answerVisibility: Only givens and pronumerals; no completed answers.

answer.short: $a=45^\circ,\ b=73^\circ,\ c=73^\circ,\ d=62^\circ,\ e=135^\circ,\ f=45^\circ,\ g=73^\circ$.
answer.worked:
Alternate angles on parallel lines give $a=45^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}b+107&=180\\b&=73^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angles on a straight line give $b=73^\circ$. Alternate angles give $c=73^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}d+73+45&=180\\d+118&=180\\d&=62^\circ\end{align*}$$
The interior angles of a triangle sum to $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}e+45&=180\\e&=135^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angles on a straight line give $e=135^\circ$. Vertically opposite angles give $f=a=45^\circ$ and $g=b=73^\circ$.
